about.title: I build bots that free you from messaging
about.text: I came to AI from front-end development and completed the AI Specialist course at AI LAB. I build AI receptionists for appointment-based businesses and count every cent of running cost: services should cost less than an hour of a receptionist's time.

items.q: We already have online booking (Booksy, Altegio). Why a bot?
items.a: Online booking is a form the client has to find and fill in. The bot answers where the client already writes, in plain language: prices, masters, free time. If your system has an API the bot books straight into it; if not, it sends the client your booking link. Plus reminders and bringing clients back.

items.q: Won't a bot put clients off?
items.a: The bot writes in your tone and doesn't pretend to be human. Complex questions and complaints go to you. Most clients are glad to get an answer right away instead of the next morning.
A first working version takes a few days. A full launch with your services, masters and reminders takes 1–3 weeks, depending on the number of masters and services.

items.q: What does it cost to run?
items.a: Services (Make, AI, the sheet) usually cost tens of dollars a month. I design the system to keep that minimal and show the estimate before we start.
No. Services, prices, masters and schedules live in a regular Google Sheet that you edit yourself. I set everything up and train your team.
